title: Farming Gold... Vegetables? Part II
description: Farming Gold... Vegetables? Part II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Are you up for another golded vegetable run? We are churning through them as soon as we get them, but there still is no cure in sight.

Bring the required amount of golded vegetables to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you have them.

Turn-in:

I wonder if these are organic? Let me know when you want to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×5
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×15

Client level range: 86–100
